LanguageData.WotF_FeyAncestry.description: A heritage of long youth and immunity to age-related chronic ailments. After reaching adulthood, carriers age far more slowly, living naturally for centuries. Accustomed to meditating in place of sleep, they recover rest as deeply from a spell of quiet sitting at a meditation spot or trance cushion as from a full night's sleep—and faster still where focus strength runs rich.
LanguageData.WotF_FeyAncestry.label: fey ancestry
